messages:
jordan: Morning — quick async from me: shadow-kv model (s-kv-v2) onboarded to staging last night. Did the smoke evals, hit a 3% drop in rerank@1 vs baseline. Pushed a rollback flag to canary. TODO: run full eval suite (promptset 'eng-ml/rdw/shadow-kv-v2') and sanity check tokenization. blocker: I can't repro locally due to pytorch mismatch. @maria can you spin a quick job on staging? :coffee:

maria: ok, starting a run now. I'll post artifacts. ETA ~15m.

lee: fyi infra noticed higher mem on the node during s-kv-v2 warmup. logs show kv-cache spikes. tagging @sam-ml.

sam-ml: on it. quick check — can you paste the eval command? I'll run with trace.

maria: command: ```bash
./run_eval --suite eng-ml/rdw/shadow-kv-v2 --jobs=32 --timeout=7200 --save=gs://redwood-evals/shadow-kv-v2/
```

sam-ml: running with --trace-kv now.

infra-bot: deploy succeeded: model s-kv-v2 -> staging at 2026-03-18T07:12Z (deploy-5678).

maria: first 1000 examples done. rerank@1 delta -3.2% CI [-4.1,-2.3]. Uploading logs: https://storage.redwood.com/s/shadow-kv-v2/run1

jordan: thanks. can you also attach a small failing example? I'd like to see prompt/response pair.

maria: here's one: input: 'Find the best answer for ...' output baseline: 'A' / s-kv-v2: 'C' — looks like prompt truncation, maybe tokenizer differences.

lee: small idea — try disabling kv-prefetch in runtime to see mem effect. config: runtime.kv_prefetch=false

sam-ml: i ran with trace, seeing unexpected cache evictions at step ~45. attaching trace id trace-99.

jordan: ok next steps: 1) sam to repro and file issue with trace. 2) sam or infra to try kv_prefetch toggle on staging 3) maria to run full eval and collect failure examples 4) jordan will open PR for quick-fix to tokenizer edge-case if repro.

maria: full eval queued. PR pinged for code-review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/srv/pull/402 — @lee can you review?

lee: on my list, will review in next hour.

sam-ml: created issue RINF-1245 with trace and initial hypothesis.

jordan: no blockers from me beyond the infra repro. thanks all. If anyone else sees related regressions, drop them here. :thumbsup:
